source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in out:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = out[sr][sc]
            if color == background or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            comp = set()
            q = [(sr, sc)]
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            while q:
                r, c = q.pop()
                comp.add((r, c))
                for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                        nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                        if (dr or dc) and 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and out[nr][nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nr, nc))
                            q.append((nr, nc))
            neighbors = {}
            for r, c in comp:
                neighbors[(r, c)] = {(r+dr, c+dc) for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1)
                                     if (dr or dc) and (r+dr, c+dc) in comp}
            endpoints = [p for p, ns in neighbors.items() if len(ns) == 1]
            if len(comp) < 2 or len(endpoints) != 2:
                continue
            free = []
            for r, c in endpoints:
                attached = any(0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= c+dc < w and out[r+dr][c+dc] not in (background, color)
                               for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1) if dr or dc)
                if not attached:
                    free.append((r, c))
            if len(free) != 1:
                continue
            r, c = free[0]
            (pr, pc) = next(iter(neighbors[(r, c)]))
            dr, dc = r-pr, c-pc
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and out[nr][nc] == background:
                out[nr][nc] = color
                nr, nc = nr+dr, nc+dc
    return out
'''
